text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine together with Aston 
Machan, who hasn't been in top form 
lately.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Understood? Bow before passing under the 
torii gate, and avoid walking down the 
center of the path.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
When worshipping, it's two bows, two 
claps, and one bow. The angle of the bow 
is 90 degrees. I brought a shiny 5-yen 
coin for the offering.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. Chan has known the gods ever since 
she was little. There are no oversights 
here. Because—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That was back before Machan aimed to 
enroll at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Young Chan
text_block_list.text:
Chan wishes to become a mascot that 
everyone will remember.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then Chan-Me met an Umamusume mascot. 
Since then, she has never failed to be 
polite.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Dear God, please. Please lend us your 
strength so that Machan can get well.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everything is perfect now. Chan-me can do 
her best with peace of mind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is big. Ever since 
yesterday, new merchandise ideas have been 
popping up in my head one after another.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, Chan is full of energy. 
Yay-ho-ho-i, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe. We really should be giving thanks to 
God, shouldn't we?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Auugh... I just can't come up with any 
ideas for new merchandise...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's condition just wouldn't 
improve...
